title: Partitioning a bipartite graph into proportional factors

statement.text: Let ''G=(V,E)'' be a bipartite graph, and <math>c_1,\dots c_k</math> positive reals whose sum is 1. Can ''E'' always be partitioned into ''k'' parts <math>E_1,\dots,E_k,</math> so that for every <math>v \in V</math> and every <math>i \in \{1,\dots,k\}</math> we have <math>\lfloor c_i d_E(v) \rfloor \leq d_{E_i}(v) \leq \lceil c_i d_E(v)  \rceil</math>?

status_observation.evidence: pinned EGRES Open MediaWiki revision and categories
